Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Class IOUtils

java.lang.Object
sc.fiji.snt.util.IOUtils
public final class IOUtils extends Object
Static utilities for file I/O, namely the detection of reconstruction file formats.

Tiago Ferreira

    • detectFormat

      public static IOUtils.ReconstructionFormat detectFormat(InputStream is, boolean closeStreamAfterGuess) throws IOException
      Guesses the format of a reconstruction file from its first bytes (not its extension): gzip magic number, XML (Neurolucida if the header holds an <mbf> root element), JSON ('{'), NDF ('/'), or SWC otherwise.
      Parameters:
      is - the stream to be inspected. If it supports marking, it is reset after inspection (unless closeStreamAfterGuess is true)
      closeStreamAfterGuess - whether is should be closed after inspection
      Returns:
      the detected format
      Throws:
      IOException - if an IO error occurs

    • detectFormat

      public static IOUtils.ReconstructionFormat detectFormat(File file) throws IOException
      Guesses the format of a reconstruction file from its first bytes. See detectFormat(InputStream, boolean)
      Parameters:
      file - the file to be inspected
      Returns:
      the detected format
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file could not be read

    • getReconstructionExtensions

      public static String[] getReconstructionExtensions()
      Returns the extensions (lower case, without the leading period) of the supported reconstruction formats that can be identified by name alone, i.e., not including Neurolucida .xml files. The order is that of preference when looking for a file paired to another (e.g., an image): the native TRACES format first
      Returns:
      a new array of extensions, e.g., "traces", "swc", etc.
      See Also:
      • getReconstructionExtensions(boolean)

    • getReconstructionExtensions

      public static String[] getReconstructionExtensions(boolean includeXml)
      Returns the extensions (lower case, without the leading period) of the supported reconstruction formats, optionally including "xml". Neurolucida files cannot be told apart from other XML files by name, so "xml" is only suitable for, e.g., file choosers, with files being validated afterwards (see isReconstructionFile(File, boolean))
      Parameters:
      includeXml - whether "xml" should be included
      Returns:
      a new array of extensions, e.g., "traces", "swc", "eswc", etc.

      Returns:
      a new array of extensions

      public static boolean isReconstructionFile(File file)
      Checks if a file is a reconstruction file based on its extension only (SWC, TRACES, JSON or NDF). Neurolucida XML files are not recognized by this method, see isReconstructionFile(File, boolean)
      Parameters:

    • isReconstructionFile

      public static boolean isReconstructionFile(File file, boolean sniffXml)
      Checks if a file is a reconstruction file. Apart from the extension-only check, XML files are recognized as Neurolucida reconstructions if sniffXml is true and their header is that of a Neurolucida file. Only the first few KB of XML files are read.
      Parameters:
      file - the file to be tested
      sniffXml - whether .xml files should be inspected
      Returns:
      true if the file is a supported reconstruction file

    • listReconstructionFiles

      public static List<File> listReconstructionFiles(File... files)
      Flattens files and directories (searched recursively) into a list of reconstruction files, as defined by isReconstructionFile(File, boolean) with sniffXml set to true. Null entries, unreadable directories and non-reconstruction files are skipped. Typically used to process dropped items. The search is bounded: at most 10,000 files are returned. See listReconstructionFiles(int, File...). May block on slow file systems: do not call it from the Event Dispatch Thread
      Parameters:
      files - the files and/or directories to be flattened. Null allowed
      Returns:
      the reconstruction files found (empty if none)

    • listReconstructionFiles

      public static List<File> listReconstructionFiles(int maxFiles, File... files)
      Flattens files and directories (searched recursively) into a list of reconstruction files, as defined by isReconstructionFile(File, boolean) with sniffXml set to true. The search stops once maxFiles files have been found, does not descend more than 16 levels below the specified items, and does not follow symbolic links to folders below the specified items (which guards against cycles). Null entries, unreadable directories and non-reconstruction files are skipped. May block on slow file systems: do not call it from the Event Dispatch Thread
      Parameters:
      maxFiles - the maximum number of files to return
      files - the files and/or directories to be flattened. Null allowed
      Returns:
      the reconstruction files found (empty if none)

    • listReconstructionSources

      public static List<File> listReconstructionSources(File... files)
      Flattens files and directories (searched recursively) into a list of sources that Tree.listFromFile(String) can read: reconstruction files (see isReconstructionFile(File, boolean) with sniffXml set to true) and zip archives of reconstructions (see isReconstructionZip(File)). Same limits as listReconstructionFiles(File...). May block on slow file systems: do not call it from the Event Dispatch Thread
      Parameters:
      files - the files and/or directories to be flattened. Null allowed
      Returns:
      the sources found (empty if none)

    • listFiles

      public static List<File> listFiles(int maxFiles, Predicate<File> filter, File... files)
      Flattens files and directories (searched recursively) into a list of files accepted by a filter. The search stops once maxFiles files have been found, does not descend more than 16 levels below the specified items, and does not follow symbolic links to folders below the specified items (which guards against cycles). Null entries and unreadable directories are skipped. May block on slow file systems: do not call it from the Event Dispatch Thread
      Parameters:
      maxFiles - the maximum number of files to return
      filter - the condition files (not folders) must meet to be listed
      files - the files and/or directories to be flattened. Null allowed
      Returns:
      the files found (empty if none)

    • listTopLevelReconstructionFiles

      public static List<File> listTopLevelReconstructionFiles(File dir, int maxFiles)
      Lists the reconstruction files at the top level of a folder (not recursive), as defined by isReconstructionFile(File, boolean) with sniffXml set to true. Unlike listReconstructionFiles(File...), the search is bounded: at most maxFiles files are returned (the first ones by name), and at most 10,000 folder entries are examined. Hidden files are skipped, symbolic links are not followed into folders, and an unreadable folder yields the files found so far. May block on slow file systems: do not call it from the Event Dispatch Thread
      Parameters:
      dir - the folder to be searched
      maxFiles - the maximum number of files to return
      Returns:
      the reconstruction files found, sorted by name (empty if none)

    • extractZip

      public static File extractZip(File zipFile, boolean reconstructionsOnly) throws IOException
      Extracts a local zip archive into a new temporary directory. The folder is deleted when the JVM exits, but callers that no longer need the contents should delete it earlier, see deleteRecursively(File). The archive is left untouched.
      Parameters:
      zipFile - the archive
      reconstructionsOnly - if true, only entries that may be reconstruction files (see IOUtils.FileType.isReconstructionCandidate()) are extracted, skipping hidden entries and those under __MACOSX/
      Returns:
      the temporary directory holding the extracted contents
      Throws:
      IOException - if the archive could not be read, if it contains an entry that would extract outside the target directory ("zip-slip") or that has an invalid name, or if its contents would take more than half of the free space of the temporary folder (e.g., a "zip bomb"). The number of entries is not limited. Nothing is left on disk if the extraction fails

    • extractZip

      public static File extractZip(File zipFile, Predicate<String> entryFilter) throws IOException
      Extracts the entries of a local zip archive accepted by a filter into a new temporary directory. Same safeguards as extractZip(File, boolean).
      Parameters:
      zipFile - the archive
      entryFilter - the condition entry names (using '/' or '\\' as separators) must meet to be extracted. Folder entries are skipped
      Returns:
      the temporary directory holding the extracted contents
      Throws:
      IOException - see extractZip(File, boolean)
      See Also:
      • isReconstructionEntry(String)
      • isSWCEntry(String)

    • httpClient

      public static okhttp3.OkHttpClient httpClient()
      Gets the HTTP client shared by SNT's remote loaders (NeuroMorpho, MouseLight, etc.), creating it if needed. Sharing a single client reuses connections and avoids leaving a connection pool, with its background daemon threads for every request. Release it with disposeHttpClient()
      Returns:
      the shared client

    • disposeHttpClient

      public static void disposeHttpClient()
      Releases the resources (idle connections and their threads) of the client returned by httpClient(). It is safe to call at any time: requests in progress are not interrupted and a new client is created on the next request
